# Materials and Methods

## Dataset and experimental design

Publicly available expression data were obtained from GEO accession GSE98923. The baseline analysis used a balanced subset of **`r nrow(samples)` samples** comprising Cabernet Sauvignon and Pinot noir, three developmental stages (FruitSet, Veraison, and Harvest), three years (2012-2014), and three replicates per cultivar-stage-year combination.

## Expression preprocessing

The processed RPKM matrix distributed with GSE98923 was used as the expression source. The selected expression matrix contained **`r nrow(expr)` genes** across **`r ncol(expr)` samples**. Values were transformed as \(\log_2(\mathrm{RPKM}+1)\) before co-expression analysis.

## Co-expression network analysis

Gene co-expression analysis was performed in R using CEMiTool. Pearson correlation was used with an unsigned network and signed TOM. CEMiTool filtering was enabled with `filter_pval = 0.1`, `apply_vst = FALSE`, and a minimum module size of 30.

Automatic beta selection did not return a usable value in the initial baseline analysis. For reproducibility of the established baseline, the soft-thresholding power was fixed at **beta = 10** with `set_beta = 10` and `force_beta = FALSE`. This parameter is specific to the present sample set and preprocessing and should be re-evaluated if either changes. A random seed of 1234 was used.

Software versions are provided in `logs/session_info.txt`.
